text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but I should not trim a stock automatically just because it has risen; weigh its prospects and portfolio role.","Repeatedly selling Stock A and D reduced my exposure, so I should consider how trades affect diversification and future participation in gains.","Short-term account values have moved both up and down; I should make decisions based on a consistent plan rather than recent results or the comfort of locking in gains."]}
